# Round 2 onboarding clarifications

Please answer one choice per item. Proposed defaults are shown in bold.

1. **Primary-advisor assignment — Whitfield, Vandermeer, Petit and Delgado.** The affected households and accounts are: George Whitfield / Whitfield / CU-5005 (Pershing; $670,000; as of 2025-06-30); Joris Vandermeer / Vandermeer / CU-6021 (Pershing; $1,620,000; as of 2025-06-30); Louis Petit / Petit / CU-6020 (Schwab; $540,000; as of 2025-06-30); and Maria Delgado / Delgado / CU-5004 / Review — Delgado (Schwab; $1,240,000; as of 2024-12-31). Each has no primary Advisor. Whitfield has Service Rep "A. Novak"; Petit and Delgado have Service Rep "Marcus Webb"; Vandermeer has no Service Rep. Which current roster advisor should own each household? **Default: Option B — exclude each household and account from reporting until you assign the current roster advisor.**

2. **Farouk status.** Omar Farouk / Farouk Household / CU-6035 (Schwab; $1,660,000; as of 2025-06-30) is marked "Active" and tagged "Deceased." Should the Farouk household be set INACTIVE because the CRM record is tagged "Deceased"? **Default: Option B — set the Farouk household INACTIVE pending estate-handling instructions.**

3. **Nakamura IRA household treatment.** Kenji Nakamura / Nakamura Holdings LLC / Nakamura / CU-5011 (Fidelity; $210,000; as of 2025-06-30) is undecided between the LLC household and Kenji's own household. Should CU-5011 be reported under the Nakamura LLC household or separately under Kenji Nakamura? **Default: Option C — exclude CU-5011 from reporting until the household treatment is confirmed.**

4. **Unmatched custodian accounts.** Carlos Vasquez / CU-5010 (Schwab; $980,000; as of 2025-06-30) and Priyanka Mehta / CU-6025 (Schwab; $670,000; as of 2025-06-30) do not match an existing CRM household. Which existing CRM household should receive each account? **Option A:** identify and link each account to an existing household. **Option B:** confirm either person is a new client and provide the household record for CRM onboarding. **Option C — proposed default:** exclude each account from reporting until it is matched to exactly one household.

5. **Stale valuation.** Oliver Ashford / Ashford / CU-6024 (Fidelity; $1,450,000; as of 2024-09-30) belongs to an active household, while the available quarter-end is 2025-06-30. Should CU-6024 be refreshed to 2025-06-30, or held out of current active AUM until that valuation is available? **Default: Option C — exclude CU-6024 from current active AUM until a 2025-06-30 valuation is available.**
